focus_areas: Hoof integrity and count (ensure exactly one per leg)
Mane and tail attachment points (check for melting/fusion)
Coat color uniformity (ensure no accidental black points on legs/mane/tail)
Edge separation between horse hooves and grass (check for blending)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hooves; AI often struggles with rendering distinct, single hooves, sometimes merging them or adding extra digits. Verify that the mane flows naturally from the crest of the neck without blending into the shoulder muscle. Check the eye visibility despite the downward head angle to ensure it doesn't look like a smooth, featureless surface. Crucially, use the open_vocabulary_detector results to confirm there are absolutely NO black pixels on the lower legs, mane, or tail, as this would disqualify it as a sorrel.
image_description: A full-body side view of a reddish-brown horse (sorrel/chestnut) standing in a grassy field. The horse has its head lowered towards the ground, possibly grazing or sniffing. It features a uniform coat color with a slightly lighter mane and tail. The background includes trees, a fence, and a building structure under bright daylight.
